assemble_hint: Assemble the program and load it
continue_hint: Run until a breakpoint, input or HALT
restart_hint: Reload the program and run it from the start
step_over_hint: Run the next instruction, including a whole subroutine or TRAP
step_into_hint: Run one instruction, following calls and TRAPs
step_out_hint: Run until the current subroutine or TRAP returns
run_to_cursor_hint: Run until the line with the cursor
reset_hint: Reload the program into fresh memory
edit_value_invalid: Enter a 16-bit value such as x3000, #12, -1 or 'A'
registers_hint: Click a value to edit it
registers_caption: Processor registers with their bits, hex, signed and unsigned values
saved_usp: user R6, saved during the TRAP
memory_go_to_label: Go to an address or label
memory_go_to_not_found: No such address or label. Use a hex address like x3000 or a label from your program.
console_hint: Click here and type to send keys to the program. It decides whether to echo them.
console_waiting: The program is waiting for a key. Type to continue.
breakpoints_empty: No breakpoints yet. Click the gutter next to a line, use the dot in the memory table, or add one here. A condition and a hit count are optional.
watchpoints_empty: No watchpoints yet. A watchpoint pauses right after an instruction reads or writes the address.
error_no_address: No such address or label. Use a hex address like x3000 or a label from your program.
error_condition: Not a valid condition. Use registers, N, Z, P, numbers like x41 or #65, and operators such as == != < && || & |.
error_hit_count: Use a whole number from 1 up.
trace_caption: The most recent instructions, newest first, with what each changed
trace_running: The trace shows the latest instructions when the machine pauses.
trace_empty: No instructions yet. Step or run the program to fill the trace.
registers_hint_fixed: Click a value to edit it, e.g. 0.75
name_error_invalid: Other files import this file by its name, so use only letters, digits and _, starting with a letter or _ (for example trig.asm).
name_error_reserved: lc3os is the name of the operating system file.
file_entry_hint: The program starts in this file
file_replace_one_confirm: Replace {file} with the file you picked?
project_replace_confirm: Replace all the files in the project? Your changes are not saved anywhere else.
problems_empty: No problems in the last assemble.
link_map_empty: Assemble the project to see where each file goes in memory.
folder_delete_confirm: Delete the folder {folder} and the {count} files in it? This can't be undone.
folder_delete_entry: {folder} holds the entry file {entry}. Set another file as entry first.
name_error_folder_invalid: Use letters, digits, _, - and . in folder names, starting with a letter, digit or _.
